title: Activator kind: flow dir: down
call: A call | past Before @gray
[Activator] blue ready: Worker ready? failed: Function Failed? hold: Hold and wake | one wake per Function intime: Ready in time? | invoke.activationTimeout 30 s [/]
worker: Worker | the Function's code @blue r2: 503 after 30 s | not ready in time @red r1: 503 at once | Function is Failed @red reclaim: Idle reclaim | every 30 s @blue
call > ready ready > failed: no ready > worker: yes failed > r1: yes failed > hold: no hold > intime intime > worker: yes intime > r2: no worker -- reclaim: stops it when idle
